scope: CPU-only audit of existing six-run validation artifacts, saved provenance, data and hashes. No training, model/tensor loading, inference, GPU, production replacement, test/final-test evaluation, or process controls performed.

selection.rule: configuration mean macro-F1 over all three seeds, then highest saved validation macro-F1 within winning configuration

training_state_comparison.note: Export state adds the final training summary after checkpoint save; checkpoint selection, steps, all other state fields and full checkpoint log agree.

limits_and_flags.trainer_vs_saved_metric_note: Trainer checkpoint selection uses epoch validation under BF16 autocast. Saved standalone FP32 validation predictions define all recomputed comparison metrics here. Selected Trainer best macro-F1 is 0.6331196558908103; saved-prediction macro-F1 is 0.6320773784509708.
remaining_scientific_limitations: Original labels have not completed independent human adjudication.
Raw/normalized full-source hash disjointness does not certify absence of near-duplicate leakage.
The validation split has been used in development and checkpoint selection; no final-test generalization claim is made.
Three seeds characterize this training comparison; the selected single checkpoint score is a validation selection result.

brief: All six runs are complete and existing saved validation predictions reproduce metrics and confusion matrices. The original-context baseline wins configuration mean over three seeds, and baseline_seed_2026 is the selected validation candidate. Publication/production readiness and final-test generalization are outside this audit.
